name: Stage 12:1: Mölnbo IP to Etapp 12
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 12:1, Mölnbo IP to Etapp 12.
utilities: Mölnbo commuter rail station is the practical public-transport access point; the signed approach adds about 1 km before the official Mölnbo IP stage start. Some maps/signs show about 5-5.6 km when this station approach is included.
Mölnbo station is served by SL commuter rail toward Södertälje/Gnesta and local bus context such as 786, but timetables should be checked live.

24Food Mölnbo and other station-area services such as Abbe's restaurang/cafe/livs are useful for resupply before/after the connector, but no all-hours public toilet or outdoor tap was verified on the forest section.

Mölnbo IP has nearby parking and sports-facility infrastructure. OSM maps a free wheelchair-accessible toilet near the IP/Bergabadet area, and Södertälje confirms Bergabadet toilets seasonally, but public access should be verified outside the bathing season.

Bergabadet is nearby seasonal beach/service context rather than a core trail facility: toilets are listed June-August, and local rules prohibit camping, grilling, fishing, alcohol, and dogs during 1 June-31 August.
Fristastugan by Bergasjön is a bookable Sörmlandsleden lodging/rest hut with kitchen and sauna context, not an open first-come trail shelter and not a free overnight facility.
waterSources: No verified potable water tap is on stage 12:1; carry water from town or resupply at station-area services.
Bergasjön/Norrbysjön and Akaren provide natural lake water and bathing/rest context only. Filter/boil/treat, and do not treat them as potable refill points.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official stage 12:1 is a 4 km connector from Mölnbo IP to the stage 12 junction. The station approach adds about 1 km, and OSM/signage/blog/AllTrails sources commonly show about 5-5.6 km when access walking is included.

For route drawing, keep two separate concepts: the optional Mölnbo station access spur to Mölnbo IP, and the official Mölnbo IP-to-Stage 12 connector. OSM relation 2390743 is useful, but its roughly 5 km tag includes the station-side access while Naturkartan and Sörmlandsleden list 4 km for the official connector.
The route is easy to moderate overall, with boardwalk/wetland terrain by Bergasjön/Norrbysjön and more hilly ground toward Akaren before it joins stage 12.

Official 2025 trail comments reported bark-beetle affected and felled trees that did not block the trail then, but made it a poor choice in windy weather. A later 2025 comment warned of long grass in late summer. Treat these as dated condition warnings, not official closures.

After rain or snowmelt, expect wetter ground around the Bergasjön/Norrbysjön boardwalks. Late-summer long grass also raises tick exposure, so this connector is not as frictionless as its short distance suggests.
The trail passes through Sjundareviret wolf territory according to the official page; this is a wildlife awareness note, not a closure.
Keep dogs controlled throughout; national wildlife-protection rules are stricter 1 March-20 August, and Bergabadet separately bans dogs on the bathing area 1 June-31 August.

No official campsite, overnight shelter, or prepared Sörmlandsleden shelter was verified on this connector. The Bergasjön wind shelter reported by Grillplatser is in very poor condition and should not be treated as usable overnight shelter.

Use only prepared fire/grill places such as Bergasjön or Akaren where allowed, and check current fire bans before lighting a fire. Fixed public fireplaces can still be closed by stricter bans, and nearby reserve fire rules apply if continuing onto Stage 12.
Bergabadet bathing-water samples can say the lake is suitable for swimming during season, but that is not drinking-water approval. Do not map Bergasjön, Norrbysjön, or Akaren as potable water.

At the Stage 12 junction around 59.081138, 17.426726, the main route continues east toward Vattgruvan/Järna services and west toward Yngsviken/Stora Alsjön; Stora Kobäcken and Vattgruvsmossen toilet/parking are Stage 12 continuation facilities, not core Stage 12:1.

facilities.name: Mölnbo station
facilities.description: Commuter rail and bus access about 1 km before the official Mölnbo IP stage start; check current SL departures.

facilities.name: Mölnbo station access spur caveat
facilities.description: Station-side OSM/signage endpoint for the access walk. Keep this as an optional access spur to Mölnbo IP; do not merge it into the official 4 km Stage 12:1 distance unless the user chooses station start.

facilities.name: Mölnbo station bus stop east
facilities.description: Station-side bus stop context, including local bus 786 patterns. Check live SL departures before relying on it.

facilities.name: Rosendal bus stop context
facilities.description: OSM-mapped side-access bus context near the station-to-Mölnbo IP approach. Useful only if live service fits the trip.

facilities.name: 24Food Mölnbo
facilities.description: Station-area 24/7 resupply listed by Sörmlandsleden and municipal records; useful before/after the connector, not an outdoor trail tap.

facilities.name: Abbe's restaurang/cafe/livs
facilities.description: Station-area food/cafe/livs context from map research. Treat as opening-hours dependent and verify before relying on it.

facilities.name: Mölnbo IP start/parking
facilities.description: Official stage start with nearby parking. Södertälje confirms parking in connection with the sports facility, but exact visitor capacity should be checked locally.

facilities.name: Official Stage 12:1 start
facilities.description: Canonical start for distance/filtering is Mölnbo IP. The station approach is a separate optional spur, so official Stage 12:1 remains 4 km.

facilities.name: Bergabadet seasonal beach services
facilities.description: Nearby seasonal bathing-place context with toilets June-August, changing rooms, accessible ramp, jetty/diving tower, free parking, and strict local rules: no camping, grilling, fishing, or alcohol; dogs prohibited 1 Jun-31 Aug.

facilities.name: Bergabadet parking
facilities.description: Free seasonal bathing-place parking near Bergabadet; useful for local access but separate from the official Mölnbo IP trail start. Check local signs before overnight parking.

facilities.name: Bergabadet beach rules
facilities.description: Rule marker: municipal beach rules prohibit camping, grilling, fishing, and alcohol; dogs are not allowed on the beach 1 June-31 August. Bathing-water monitoring is not drinking-water verification.

facilities.name: Dog-control warning
facilities.description: Keep dogs controlled on the trail; Swedish wildlife-protection rules are stricter 1 Mar-20 Aug, and Bergabadet has its own summer dog ban on the bathing area.

facilities.name: Bergasjön grill/rest point
facilities.description: Grillplats.nu lists a prepared grill/rest point by the lake. The mapped wind shelter is reported in very poor condition with roof damage and should not be treated as usable overnight shelter.

facilities.name: Bergasjön lake water
facilities.description: Lake/bathing water near the early route; filter/boil/treat and carry backup.

facilities.name: Fristastugan bookable lodging
facilities.description: Bookable Sörmlandsleden lodging/rest hut by Bergasjön with kitchen/sauna context. It is not an open public lean-to and should not be presented as free first-come trail shelter.

facilities.name: Norrbysjön/Bergasjön boardwalk
facilities.description: Wetland and boardwalk section between Bergasjön and overgrown Norrbysjön; recent user reports describe this stretch as wetter in spring.

facilities.name: Felled spruce / wind warning
facilities.description: Official community comments in May 2025 reported many bark-beetle affected or felled trees. They were not blocking the trail then, but the route was discouraged in windy weather until newer conditions are checked.

facilities.name: Long grass / tick-season caution
facilities.description: Late-2025 official comments warned about long grass. In late summer, choose long trousers and do tick checks after the hike.

facilities.name: Akaren fireplace/rest point
facilities.description: Prepared grill/rest point by Akaren, a commonly reported break and bathing area on the connector. Check fire bans.

facilities.name: Akaren lake water
facilities.description: Natural lake water and bathing/rest context only; filter/boil/treat.

facilities.name: Etapp 12 junction
facilities.description: Exact shared node where stage 12:1 joins Stage 12; continue east toward Vattgruvan/Järna and Stora Kobäcken/Vattgruvsmossen services, or west toward Yngsviken/Stora Alsjön.

facilities.name: Mölnbo IP / Bergabadet toilet (verify)
facilities.description: OSM lists a free wheelchair-accessible toilet near Mölnbo IP/Bergabadet. Official trail sources do not confirm all-hours public access; Bergabadet municipal toilets are seasonal.

facilities.name: Stora Kobäcken continuation shelter
facilities.description: Stage 12 continuation service about 1.1 km east of the 12:1 junction: shelter, fireplace, benches, tent context, and nearby Vattgruvsmossen toilet/parking. Bring your own wood and treat water.

facilities.name: Vattgruvsmossen continuation toilet/parking
facilities.description: Stage 12 continuation/reserve access east of the junction, useful if route-building toward Vattgruvan/Järna rather than stopping at the connector junction.

facilities.name: STF Långbro Gård
facilities.description: Optional accommodation/food context just over 2 km from stage 12:1; off-route and should be treated as a detour service.
